ruleContent.content: @js:var h=String(result||'');var i=h.indexOf('chapter_img_list');var out=[];if(i>=0){  var s=h.indexOf('[',i);var e=h.indexOf(']',s);  if(s>0&&e>s){    var seg=h.substring(s+1,e);    var re=/"(https?:[^"]+)"/g;var m;    while((m=re.exec(seg))!==null){out.push(m[1].replace(/\\u002F/g,'/'));}  }}var HD=',{"headers":{"Referer":"https://m.kanman.com/"}}';var lines=[];for(var k=0;k<out.length;k++){lines.push(out[k]+HD);}result=lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
